structured_rules.source_clause: Receipts are required for any expense over 75 USD (or local currency equivalent).
Hotels must be four stars or below.
Client dinners are reimbursable up to 150 USD per person.
SaaS subscriptions above 500 USD per month require pre-approval from the department head before purchase.
Team entertainment (team lunches, off-sites, celebrations) is reimbursable up to 75 USD per person.

natural_language_references.clause_text: Alcohol is reimbursable only when clients are present and must not exceed 20% of the total bill.
Employees should use good judgment and keep spend reasonable relative to the occasion.

unsupported_clauses.clause_text: Quarterly expense reports must be submitted to the board no later than the 15th of the month following each quarter end. Late submissions will be flagged for HR review.
unsupported_clauses.reason: Board reporting is a governance obligation, not a transaction-level rule.

unsupported_clauses.clause_text: All international travel above 1000 USD requires a travel request to be approved in Reap at least 5 business days before departure. Economy class is required for flights under 6 hours. Business class may be approved for flights over 6 hours with manager sign-off.
unsupported_clauses.reason: Travel approval and class requirements are governance obligations, not transaction-level rules.
